title: Is AI replacing more jobs than it creates?
description: The debate concerns whether AI-driven automation will displace more workers than it creates new employment opportunities.

facts.fact: The World Economic Forum projects AI and information-processing technologies will displace 9 million jobs by 2030.
41% of employers surveyed plan to reduce their workforce where AI can automate tasks.
The WEF expects technological and economic change to disrupt the equivalent of 22% of jobs by 2030.
AI and information-processing trends are projected to create 11 million jobs while displacing 9 million by 2030.
Global labour-market transformation is projected to create 170 million jobs and displace 92 million by 2030.
The projected net employment change is 78 million additional jobs, or 7% growth in total employment.
